_about: Loot tables rebuilt by build_lootpatch.py into the local 'ModCheck Loot Merge' pak, loaded near the end of the order. 'pools': merge items into a one-list pool (base + what add_from added on top of minus_base). 'subtables': base table plus every subtable later mods add, treating the listed full replacements as additions.

pools.why: AMPFEDMIX adds Fade's gear to AMP's random-loot pools; AMP Plus rewrites 29 of those pools with its new items. The patch keeps both.

subtables.why: Witcher Class replaces the Dark Shambling Mound's loot with only its decoction, wiping AMP's drops and five gear mods' additions. The patch keeps all of them.
